net_audit_script:
import sys,json,hashlib,subprocess,concurrent.futures,time
from pathlib import Path
R=Path('/Users/wjc/repos/unisacc');sys.path.insert(0,str(R/'exec/c'))
from pack import compact_q
from networkformat import encode
T=Path('/tmp/unisacc-v009-integrated');A=Path('/tmp/unisacc-release-v008/model/model-audit')
by={hashlib.sha256(compact_q(p.read_bytes())).hexdigest():p for p in A.glob('*.net')}
jobs=[]
for i in range(32):
 raw=(T/f'{i}.net').read_bytes();net=by[hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()]
 assert net.with_suffix('.tbl').is_file();binary=T/f'{i}.bin';binary.write_bytes(encode(raw));jobs.append((i,net.with_suffix('.tbl'),binary))
def check(job):
 i,table,net=job;start=time.monotonic();p=subprocess.run([str(T/'run'),'--check-net',str(table),str(net)],capture_output=True,timeout=30)
 assert p.returncode==0,(i,p.returncode,p.stderr)
 return {'model':i,'table_sha256':hashlib.sha256(table.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'binary_sha256':hashlib.sha256(net.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'stdout':p.stdout.decode(),'seconds':time.monotonic()-start}
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:results=list(pool.map(check,jobs))
(T/'net-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(results,indent=2)+'\n');print('32 binary-loaded networks: full-domain --check-net passed')
